using Xunit;
using Moq;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using System;
using Garnet.cluster;

namespace Garnet.cluster.Tests;

public class ClusterConfigTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void HandleConfigEpochCollision_NoCollision_ReturnsThis()
    {
        // Arrange
        var config = new ClusterConfig();
        var senderConfig = new ClusterConfig();
        var logger = new Mock<ILogger<ClusterConfig>>();

        // Act
        var result = config.HandleConfigEpochCollision(senderConfig, logger.Object);

        // Assert
        Assert.Same(config, result);
        logger.VerifyNoOtherCalls();
    }

    [Fact]
    public void HandleConfigEpochCollision_SenderNodeIdLesserOrEqual_ReturnsThis()
    {
        // Arrange
        var config = new ClusterConfig();
        config = config.InitializeLocalWorker("local-node-1", "127.0.0.1", 7000, 1, NodeRole.PRIMARY, null, "localhost");
        
        var senderConfig = new ClusterConfig();
        senderConfig = senderConfig.InitializeLocalWorker("sender-node-0", "127.0.0.2", 7001, 1, NodeRole.PRIMARY, null, "senderhost");
        
        var logger = new Mock<ILogger<ClusterConfig>>();

        // Act
        var result = config.HandleConfigEpochCollision(senderConfig, logger.Object);

        // Assert
        Assert.Same(config, result);
        logger.VerifyNoOtherCalls();
    }

    [Fact]
    public void HandleConfigEpochCollision_CollisionWithSenderNodeIdGreater_LogsWarningAndBumpsEpoch()
    {
        // Arrange
        var config = new ClusterConfig();
        config = config.InitializeLocalWorker("local-node-1", "127.0.0.1", 7000, 1, NodeRole.PRIMARY, null, "localhost");
        
        var senderConfig = new ClusterConfig();
        senderConfig = senderConfig.InitializeLocalWorker("sender-node-2", "127.0.0.2", 7001, 1, NodeRole.PRIMARY, null, "senderhost");
        
        var logger = new Mock<ILogger<ClusterConfig>>();
        logger.Setup(l => l.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Warning)).Returns(true);

        // Act
        var result = config.HandleConfigEpochCollision(senderConfig, logger.Object);

        // Assert
        Assert.NotSame(config, result);
        Assert.Equal(2, result.LocalNodeConfigEpoch); // maxConfigEpoch=1 (from GetMaxConfigEpoch) + 1

        logger.Verify(
            l => l.LogWarning(
                "Epoch Collision {localNodeConfigEpoch} <> {senderConfigEpoch} [{LocalNodeIp}:{LocalNodePort},{localNodeId}] [{senderIp}:{senderPort},{senderNodeId}]",
                1L,
                1L,
                "127.0.0.1",
                7000,
                "local-node-1",
                "127.0.0.2",
                7001,
                "sender-node-2"),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void HandleConfigEpochCollision_LoggerNull_NoException()
    {
        // Arrange
        var config = new ClusterConfig();
        config = config.InitializeLocalWorker("local-node-1", "127.0.0.1", 7000, 1, NodeRole.PRIMARY, null, "localhost");
        
        var senderConfig = new ClusterConfig();
        senderConfig = senderConfig.InitializeLocalWorker("sender-node-2", "127.0.0.2", 7001, 1, NodeRole.PRIMARY, null, "senderhost");

        // Act
        var result = config.HandleConfigEpochCollision(senderConfig, null);

        // Assert
        Assert.NotSame(config, result);
        Assert.Equal(2, result.LocalNodeConfigEpoch);
    }
}

using Xunit;
using Moq;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using System;
using System.Reflection;

namespace Garnet.cluster.Tests;

public class ClusterConfigTests
{
    private static ClusterConfig CreateInitializedConfig(string nodeId, string ip, int port, long epoch)
    {
        var config = Activator.CreateInstance(typeof(ClusterConfig), true) as ClusterConfig;
        var initializeMethod = typeof(ClusterConfig).GetMethod("InitializeLocalWorker", BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Instance)!;
        
        return (ClusterConfig)initializeMethod.Invoke(config!, new object[] { nodeId, ip, port, epoch, NodeRole.PRIMARY, null, "localhost" })!;
    }

    [Fact]
    public void HandleConfigEpochCollision_NoCollision_ReturnsThis()
    {
        // Arrange
        var config = CreateInitializedConfig("local-node-1", "127.0.0.1", 7000, 1);
        var senderConfig = CreateInitializedConfig("sender-node-0", "127.0.0.2", 7001, 2); // different epoch
        var logger = new Mock<ILogger>();

        // Act
        var result = InvokeHandleConfigEpochCollision(config, senderConfig, logger.Object);

        // Assert
        Assert.Same(config, result);
        logger.VerifyNoOtherCalls();
    }

    [Fact]
    public void HandleConfigEpochCollision_SenderNodeIdLesserOrEqual_ReturnsThis()
    {
        // Arrange
        var config = CreateInitializedConfig("local-node-2", "127.0.0.1", 7000, 1);
        var senderConfig = CreateInitializedConfig("sender-node-1", "127.0.0.2", 7001, 1); // same epoch, smaller nodeId
        
        var logger = new Mock<ILogger>();

        // Act
        var result = InvokeHandleConfigEpochCollision(config, senderConfig, logger.Object);

        // Assert
        Assert.Same(config, result);
        logger.VerifyNoOtherCalls();
    }

    [Fact]
    public void HandleConfigEpochCollision_CollisionWithSenderNodeIdGreater_LogsWarningAndBumpsEpoch()
    {
        // Arrange
        var config = CreateInitializedConfig("local-node-1", "127.0.0.1", 7000, 1);
        var senderConfig = CreateInitializedConfig("sender-node-2", "127.0.0.2", 7001, 1); // same epoch, greater nodeId
        
        var logger = new Mock<ILogger>();
        logger.Setup(l => l.IsEnabled(Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.LogLevel.Warning)).Returns(true);

        // Act
        var result = InvokeHandleConfigEpochCollision(config, senderConfig, logger.Object);

        // Assert
        Assert.NotSame(config, result);

        // Verify warning was logged with correct parameters
        logger.Verify(
            l => l.LogWarning(
                "Epoch Collision {localNodeConfigEpoch} <> {senderConfigEpoch} [{LocalNodeIp}:{LocalNodePort},{localNodeId}] [{senderIp}:{senderPort},{senderNodeId}]",
                It.Is<long>(e => e == 1),
                It.Is<long>(e => e == 1),
                It.Is<string>(ip => ip == "127.0.0.1"),
                It.Is<int>(port => port == 7000),
                It.Is<string>(id => id == "local-node-1"),
                It.Is<string>(ip => ip == "127.0.0.2"),
                It.Is<int>(port => port == 7001),
                It.Is<string>(id => id == "sender-node-2")),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void HandleConfigEpochCollision_LoggerNull_NoException()
    {
        // Arrange
        var config = CreateInitializedConfig("local-node-1", "127.0.0.1", 7000, 1);
        var senderConfig = CreateInitializedConfig("sender-node-2", "127.0.0.2", 7001, 1);

        // Act
        var result = InvokeHandleConfigEpochCollision(config, senderConfig, null);

        // Assert
        Assert.NotSame(config, result);
    }

    private static ClusterConfig InvokeHandleConfigEpochCollision(ClusterConfig config, ClusterConfig senderConfig, ILogger logger)
    {
        var method = typeof(ClusterConfig).GetMethod("HandleConfigEpochCollision", 
            BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Instance, 
            null, 
            new[] { typeof(ClusterConfig), typeof(ILogger) }, 
            null)!;
        
        return (ClusterConfig)method.Invoke(config, new object?[] { senderConfig, logger })!;
    }
}

using Xunit;
using Moq;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using System;
using System.Reflection;

namespace Garnet.cluster.Tests;

public class ClusterConfigTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void HandleConfigEpochCollision_LogsWarningOnEpochCollision()
    {
        // Arrange
        var logger = new Mock<ILogger>();
        logger.Setup(l => l.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Warning)).Returns(true);

        // Use reflection to create and invoke internal method
        var configType = Type.GetType("Garnet.cluster.ClusterConfig, Garnet.cluster")!;
        var config = Activator.CreateInstance(configType, true)!;
        
        var initializeMethod = configType.GetMethod("InitializeLocalWorker", 
            BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Instance)!;
        config = (dynamic)initializeMethod.Invoke(config, new object[] { "local-node-1", "127.0.0.1", 7000, 1L, 0, null, "localhost" })!; // 0 = NodeRole.PRIMARY
        
        var senderConfig = Activator.CreateInstance(configType, true)!;
        senderConfig = (dynamic)initializeMethod.Invoke(senderConfig, new object[] { "sender-node-2", "127.0.0.2", 7001, 1L, 0, null, "senderhost" })!;

        var handleMethod = configType.GetMethod("HandleConfigEpochCollision",
            BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Instance,
            null,
            new[] { configType, typeof(ILogger) },
            null)!;

        // Act
        handleMethod.Invoke(config, new object[] { senderConfig, logger.Object });

        // Assert - verify the LogWarning extension method call was made
        logger.Verify(
            l => l.Log(
                LogLevel.Warning,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Epoch Collision 1 <> 1")),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void HandleConfigEpochCollision_NoLoggerProvided_DoesNotThrow()
    {
        // Arrange
        var configType = Type.GetType("Garnet.cluster.ClusterConfig, Garnet.cluster")!;
        var config = Activator.CreateInstance(configType, true)!;
        var initializeMethod = configType.GetMethod("InitializeLocalWorker", BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Instance)!;
        config = (dynamic)initializeMethod.Invoke(config, new object[] { "local-node-1", "127.0.0.1", 7000, 1L, 0, null, "localhost" })!;
        
        var senderConfig = Activator.CreateInstance(configType, true)!;
        senderConfig = (dynamic)initializeMethod.Invoke(senderConfig, new object[] { "sender-node-2", "127.0.0.2", 7001, 1L, 0, null, "senderhost" })!;

        var handleMethod = configType.GetMethod("HandleConfigEpochCollision",
            BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Instance,
            null,
            new[] { configType, typeof(ILogger) },
            null)!;

        // Act & Assert
        handleMethod.Invoke(config, new object[] { senderConfig, null });
    }
}
